Widget family: SCROLL VIEW

Strict visual criteria (PASS only if ALL hold):

1. A rectangular viewport/panel is visible with a clear content area.
2. When content overflows and scrollbars are claimed: at least one scrollbar with a distinct thumb is visible.
3. Content inside the viewport is clipped to the view (no unbounded spill outside the panel border).
4. FAIL if: empty missing panel, content drawn outside the viewport chrome, or overflow without any scrollbar when the scene claims one is shown.
